events.title: Java 1.0 shipped
events.summary: JavaSoft made JDK 1.0 available for download — the first production Java development kit.
events.about: JDK 1.0 shipped the compiler, JVM, and libraries developers needed to build and run Java programs — applets in browsers, standalone tools, and early server apps. You wrote `.java` files, compiled to bytecode, and ran them anywhere with a Java runtime installed.

narrative.whyChosen: The May 1995 announcement created hype; JDK 1.0 was when developers could actually build with Java.
narrative.whyImportant: It shipped the compiler, JVM, applet viewer, and class libraries as a cohesive platform.
narrative.problemSolved: Early adopters needed stable tooling beyond alpha builds to write deployable applets and applications.

sources.title: Sun press release — JavaSoft ships Java 1.0 (Jan 23, 1996)
